parameters.question: Compare rMATS A3SS junction-count event tables, allowing column and row reordering. Require matching chromosome, position, strand, and per-sample junction counts; require PSI, p-value, and FDR values to agree within an absolute tolerance of 0.01.
Compare rMATS A5SS.MATS.JC event tables by matching alternative 5′ splice-site events using gene identifiers and genomic coordinates, allowing row and column reordering and minor numeric rounding.

Compare rMATS skipped-exon event tables by matching events using gene identifiers and genomic coordinates, allowing row and column reordering and minor numeric rounding in junction counts, inclusion levels, P-values, FDR, and inclusion-level differences.
